messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] prod-inference: GPU nodes exhausted (us-east-1). Pod queue growing, autoscaler unable to add nodes.

Sam (oncall): i'm taking the page. i see queue spike ~09:10 UTC, moving thread to #incidents. oncall-shadow joining for handoff.

Oncall Shadow: i'm with you, Sam. collecting logs.

Maria: telemetry: large increase in 5xx and token throttling. Several customers hitting retry storms. CS alerted two enterprise tenants.

Jonathan: lots of Pending pods with message: \"0/5 nodes are available: 5 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu\". kube-scheduler not placing.

Infra Bot: no automated nodegroup updates in the last 3h.

SRE Lead: pulling cluster-autoscaler logs and control plane events now. any infra deploys in last 24h?

Dave: checking infra. there was a terraform PR last night that updated the autoscaler role policy and a separate PR that touched the node bootstrap script for launch templates. both merged.

Jonathan: cluster-autoscaler shows attempts to scale but failures with 403 and also a later error about invalid launch template attributes. snippet: \n```\nE0316 09:12:45 aws_manager.go:198] create launch template version: UnauthorizedOperation: You are not authorized to perform this operation\nstatus code: 403, request id: aaaa-bbbb-cccc\nE0316 09:13:02 launch_template.go:77] launch template validation failed: missing tag node.kubernetes.io/accelerator\n```\n
Sam (oncall): 403 suggests autoscaler lost a permission. Dave, can you validate the assume-role/trust policy and policies attached?

Dave: looking at IAM now. autoscaler role still exists but policy narrowed: removed ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion and ec2:CreateTags in a restrictive change. also terraform changed the trust relationship to remove ec2.amazonaws.com as a principal used by our internal automation. appears accidental.

SRE Lead: that matches the unauthorized errors. what's the fastest safe remediation?

Dave: two-step: 1) restore ec2 permissions and restore trust relationship for autoscaler assume-role (targeted revert of last TF change) and 2) audit launch template bootstrap to re-add correct taint/labels. i'll revert trust+policy now in a targeted apply to reduce blast radius. ETA 8-12m.

Maria: customers need immediate mitigation. CS recommends we route high-priority jobs to fallback region and temporarily increase throughput quotas for impacted tenants. i'll coordinate.

Jonathan: note: even if autoscaler can create nodes, the current launch template (manually inspected) sets taint key=\"gpu_vendor=amd\" and kubelet labels absent. our scheduler expects taint key \"accelerator=nvidia\" and label node.kubernetes.io/accelerator=nvidia. any manual nodes will still be rejected.

Sam (oncall): so two simultaneous problems: IAM prevents autoscaler; launch template drift prevents placement. We need a short-term acceptance path. Options?

Jonathan: fastest low-risk fix is to add a temporary toleration to inference deployments for key \"gpu_vendor\" value \"amd\". small kustomize patch targeted to inference ns only. will accept pods on nodes with the mismatched taint. i'll prepare patch.

Dave: i can also create a small admin nodepool (manual) with correct taints via console if we want nodes with accelerator=nvidia immediately. but that'll take ~6-8m to spin up.

Oncall Shadow: which has smaller blast radius, toleration patch or manual nodepool?

Jonathan: toleration patch is less infra-blast — small k8s change. we must ensure we revert it after LT fix. i'll roll it out to a single deployment first to validate.

Sam (oncall): go ahead with toleration patch to a single deployment. Dave, proceed with IAM revert in parallel. Maria, start customer comms.

Jonathan: patch applied at 09:21:11 UTC to inference-api deployment only. snippet:\n```\n- op: add\n  path: /spec/template/spec/tolerations/-\n  value:\n    key: \"gpu_vendor\"\n    operator: \"Equal\"\n    value: \"amd\"\n    effect: \"NoSchedule\"\n```\n
Dave: reverted IAM bits at 09:23:40 UTC. terraform targeted apply completed. cluster-autoscaler logs now show assume-role success: \n```\nI0316 09:24:02 aws_manager.go:210] assume role success for arn:aws:iam::123456:role/cluster-autoscaler\nI0316 09:24:06 scale_up.go:489] NodeGroup gpu-pool: increase request submitted (desired: 9 -> 11)\n```\n
Infra Bot: autoscaler request accepted. launching instances.

Jonathan: added toleration allowed inference-api pods to land on a manually created GPU node we added earlier for emergency. backlog dropping.

Maria: queue went from ~300 -> ~90 within 10m after patch and manual node add. 5xx rate falling. CS reports one tenant routed some jobs to fallback region; they confirmed partial recovery.

Customer Success: notifying impacted customers: telling them degradation window ~40m, providing workaround and ETA.

Dave: autoscaler created new instances but I see their node labels still missing node.kubernetes.io/accelerator. Launch template lacks the kubelet bootstrap label. i'll push a launch-template patch to include correct bootstrap tags and taint key accelerator=nvidia:NoSchedule. planning a LT version create now.

SRE Lead: good. ensure we run this LT change in staging first and confirm new nodes join with expected labels.

Dave: plan: create LT version 3 with correct user-data and tags; create NG update to use version 3; autoscaler will then provision nodes with correct taint. ETA ~25m for full rollout to be safe.

Sam (oncall): for rollback plan: Jonathan will remove toleration patch once nodes have accelerator=nvidia taint; Dave will revert IAM if any regressions; Maria will confirm customer state. document all steps in the incident ticket.

Jonathan: note for postmortem: missing infra test that validates launch template taint/label invariants after terraform change. also tighten review process for IAM permission changes for autoscaler role.

SRE Lead: assigning postmortem owners: Dave (infra/launch-template), Jonathan (scheduler/runtime tolerations), Maria (customer comms + impact), Sam (incident lead). draft due in 48h.

Incident Bot: [INCIDENT] Severity: SEV-2 3 GPU capacity exhausted; mitigations applied. monitoring for 2h.

Sam (oncall): handing off to incident review. ending active paging at 09:38:40 UTC. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Customer Success: closing loop with impacted tenants; will re-open if they see regressions.

Jonathan: leaving a rollback play in k8s repo to remove temporary toleration when nodes report label node.kubernetes.io/accelerator=nvidia.

SRE Lead: timeline closed at 09:40:20 UTC. follow-ups tracked in infra#1234 and postmortem-1769901234.
